heroLead: Voyager Maps has 3,339 practical places mapped in Rio de Janeiro — the things you actually need while travelling, rather than restaurants and directions.
statsTitle: What is mapped in Rio de Janeiro
statsIntro: How many of each kind of place the map currently holds in Rio de Janeiro. These are mapped locations, not an estimate of every one that exists — coverage comes from OpenStreetMap and grows as people add to it.
ctaBlockTitle: Find these places in Rio de Janeiro on your phone
seoTitle: Finding a toilet, a tap or a shower in Rio de Janeiro
seoText: General map apps are built around businesses and directions, so the free and public things — a toilet in a park, a drinking fountain on a square, a shower at a beach — are the ones they cover least well. That is the gap this map fills. In Rio de Janeiro it currently holds 254 public toilets and 47 places to refill a bottle, each with whatever the source records about cost, opening hours and access. It works the same way in every city you travel to next.
highlight: Rio de Janeiro has 5.4 times more public toilets than places to refill a bottle — 254 against 47. Worth filling up before you set out.
